title: STAR CAT
oneLiner: Bounce across enchanted clouds and snatch falling stars before they vanish below.
hook: Choose safe cloud landings for reliable stars or take fast, risky leaps toward valuable star chains while missing a landing costs a life.
ramp: The opening cloud layout teaches one bounce and one falling star with generous spacing. Later stages alternate calm recovery clouds with denser star showers, moving clouds, and brief gaps; cap cloud H
mechanics: The cat automatically bounces when landing on a cloud; left and right steer horizontal movement in the air, with gentle acceleration and capped speed.
Clouds are solid only from above. A landing gives a readable squash flash and launches the cat upward; falling below the bottom without touching a cloud loses a life.
Stars fall vertically in marked lanes. Touching a star collects it once, awards 100 points, and produces a gold sparkle; missed stars disappear at the bottom and are not collectible later.
A star chain is available when the next star is collected within 1.5 seconds of the previous one, awarding 100, 200, then 300 points, capped at 3x; the chain resets on timeout or life loss.
Each stage scrolls upward as the cat climbs. New clouds enter from above while old clouds leave below, with a safe recovery cloud always visible after each authored hazard section.
Stage 1 uses wide stationary clouds and one star at a time. Later stages add limited horizontal cloud motion, offset cloud routes, and pairs of stars that reward choosing a risky route.
A short landing grace window prevents a fair edge landing from being lost, but the cat cannot steer through cloud undersides or land on a cloud from below.
Clear a stage by reaching its glowing moon gate after collecting enough stars; complete five compact stages to win, with a bonus for remaining lives.
The first attempt begins with a wide cloud directly beneath the cat and a slow star dropping nearby, teaching steering and bounce without an intro lock.
After a miss, respawn the cat on the last safe cloud with brief 1-second protection; reset the current chain but keep score and remaining stage progress.
artDirection: 256x224 NES-style vertical playfield with the top 12 pixels reserved for HUD. Use a readable 24x28 pixel wizard cat built from the supplied cat asset when its wait or rescued clip fits, adding a purple pointed hat, bright eyes, and a small wand silhouette through aligned pixel details. Show distinct crouched bounce, airborne, and hurt poses using simple manual overlays if needed. Clouds are 32-48 pixels wide, white and pale blue with dark-blue undersides; stars are 8x8 gold five-point pickups with a bright twinkle frame. Layer a dark indigo sky, soft moonlit cloud bands, and sparse stars behind the active playfield, keeping hazards and pickups high contrast. Reserve red-violet flashes for missed landings and gold sparkles for catches.

controls.left: Steer the airborne cat left; active during play and while bouncing.
controls.right: Steer the airborne cat right; active during play and while bouncing.
controls.a: Magically nudge the cat upward once per bounce, shortening horizontal control time but giving a higher arc; active only during ascent and once per bounce.

lose: Lose a life when the cat falls below the playfield after missing every reachable cloud; the game ends at zero lives.
scoring: Collect stars for 100 points each, with a timed chain capped at 3x and a 1,000-point stage-clear bonus.
